about: Single source of the suite columns the grader enforces, their legal values, the registry of directional items (issue 11, col_roles), the multi-instance items, the size of the extension suite and the core items repaired for the October session (D11). col_roles_syntax: '' = G1 (column order not graded); '*' = order of the whole projection graded; 'i,j;k,l' = groups of gold column indexes (from 0) whose order is graded inside each group

core_repaired.about: Core items whose question was repaired after the August run. The August core suite (k3n_suite_v1.3n.tsv; Gate 2 re-grade) keeps each of them with the original text and v13_status excluded (D3). The October core suite (k3n_suite_v1.3n_oct.tsv, built by suite_tools/build_oct_core_suite.py from the August suite and Q27_REPAIR_2026-10-14.tsv) carries the repaired question_en, question_th and gold_sql_draft, v13_status primary, v13_rule D11 and an empty gold_sql_v12 (v1.2 has no gold for the repaired question). selftest_v13n.py check 2 lets only these items differ from v1.2, and only where they are primary; check 5 accepts a core suite with exactly these items excluded (August) or none excluded (October). The prompt-byte exception of the October base arm is declared once, in check_prompts_rc1.py (D11_PROMPT_EXCEPTION).
